title: HN Group Wiki:About
---
'''HN Group Wiki''' is the encyclopedia of [[HN Group]] and its companies. It works like Wikipedia: articles have infoboxes, references and categories, and every change is kept in each page's history.

Anyone can read the wiki. HN Group staff can edit it by signing in with their staff account. To learn how, see [[Help:Editing]].

The wiki is published by HN Group Limited. For questions about its content, use the [https://hngroup.org.uk/contact HN Group contact form].
